question: Should OpenClaw accept this Vault SecretRef resolver as a bundled exec provider at the current head, including Vault auth env pass-through, network reads, plugin-policy mutations, and dependency graph changes?
rationale: The implementation uses the existing manifest-owned SecretRef seam, but bundling a resolver that receives Vault credentials and reads from the network is a security/product boundary that automation should not approve.

options.title: Approve bundled Vault after gates
options.body: Accept the plugin once secops/admin approval covers the resolver and dependency graph on the exact head and current-head CI is green.

options.title: Narrow the trust model first
options.body: Require stricter resolver, environment, docs, or setup constraints before accepting a bundled exec SecretRef provider.

options.title: Move outside core
options.body: Route Vault to ClawHub or a separately owned official plugin package if maintainers do not want this provider in the core distribution.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled Vault after gates
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin once secops/admin approval covers the resolver and dependency graph on the exact head and current-head CI is green.
